verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly documents that domains are sold at-cost with 'no hidden fees or required add-ons' and that renewals occur 'only at the list price set by the registry' (i.e., no teaser-then-spike pricing), and separate registration/renewal/transfer pricing is described across TLDs via docs and an API for checking domain costs. Community threads corroborate the at-cost model and lack of markup, with no concrete report of a teaser first-year price followed by a hidden renewal spike (complaints instead concern absolute price levels vs other registrars or billing bugs, not opaque pricing). Missing for 10: a concrete, itemized public price table per TLD (registration/renewal/transfer) rather than general 'upfront pricing' claims, and independent confirmation that pricing is fully transparent across all 400+ supported TLDs.
